tests.name: GET /api/v1/partner-health/member/link-requests answers 200 JSON { ok: true, requests: [...] } with only id/partner_display_name/test_name/proposed_at per entry; /patient/results renders on desktop and phone, fetches the link requests itself and shows the card only when a request is pending; no confirm/decline request is ever sent (read-only)

member card lists requests, hidden on empty list and on error, Results still renders when link-requests fails, confirm (after the dialog) and decline POST the right endpoint and refresh requests + results, RTL-safe classes; staff upload-result bodies carry no partner_key, confirm-match 202 pending_member toasts 'sent to the member', 409 MEMBER_DECLINED / 400 USER_NOT_IN_TENANT / 503 MEMBER_CONFIRMATION_UNAVAILABLE / 409 PENDING_MEMBER get their own error toasts, pending rows are badged and cannot be re-proposed (admin + Commerce pages)
tests.reason: Staging is read-only against the production Supabase project and the VTID-05055 migration is applied only after Gate 2, so staging can only observe the empty list and the read path. Confirming, declining and staff proposals are writes; these Vitests render the real card, Results page and both staff pages with a mocked gateway and prove every write path and error code.
